```{=html}
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Oswald:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Barlow:ital,wght@0,400;0,500;0,600;0,700;1,400;1,500&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">

<div id="pitch" aria-hidden="true"></div>
<svg id="field-svg" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" aria-hidden="true"></svg>
<div id="sprite-layer" aria-hidden="true"></div>
<div id="pitch-overlay" aria-hidden="true"></div>

<script>
(function(){
  /* ---- fixed, viewport-sized horizontal pitch (matches the PDF) ---- */
  function rect(x,y,w,h,lw){return '<rect x="'+x+'" y="'+y+'" width="'+w+'" height="'+h+'" fill="none" stroke="rgba(255,255,255,0.42)" stroke-width="'+lw+'"/>';}
  function circ(cx,cy,r){return '<circle cx="'+cx+'" cy="'+cy+'" r="'+r+'" fill="none" stroke="rgba(255,255,255,0.42)" stroke-width="2"/>';}
  function dot(cx,cy,r){return '<circle cx="'+cx+'" cy="'+cy+'" r="'+r+'" fill="rgba(255,255,255,0.42)"/>';}
  function arc(d){return '<path d="'+d+'" fill="none" stroke="rgba(255,255,255,0.42)" stroke-width="2"/>';}
  function drawField(){
    var svg=document.getElementById('field-svg'); if(!svg) return;
    /* clientWidth/Height = the content area, EXCLUDING the scrollbar. The card
       blocks are centred in this same area, so the halfway line (at W/2) lands
       exactly on the block's centred divider. Using innerWidth here would shift
       the line half a scrollbar to the right of the divider. */
    var d=document.documentElement;
    var W=d.clientWidth, H=d.clientHeight; if(H<200) return;
    svg.setAttribute('viewBox','0 0 '+W+' '+H);
    svg.setAttribute('width',W); svg.setAttribute('height',H);
    var pad=Math.round(Math.min(W,H)*0.05);
    var fx=pad, fy=pad, fw=W-2*pad, fh=H-2*pad, mx=fx+fw/2, my=fy+fh/2;
    var paH=fh*0.56, paW=fw*0.155, paY=fy+(fh-paH)/2;
    var gaH=fh*0.26, gaW=fw*0.055, gaY=fy+(fh-gaH)/2;
    var cr=Math.max(56,Math.min(fh*0.20, fw*0.13)), spot=fw*0.10, c=Math.max(14,fw/80);
    svg.innerHTML =
      rect(fx,fy,fw,fh,3)
      +'<line x1="'+mx+'" y1="'+fy+'" x2="'+mx+'" y2="'+(fy+fh)+'" stroke="rgba(255,255,255,0.42)" stroke-width="2"/>'
      +circ(mx,my,cr)+dot(mx,my,5)
      +rect(fx,paY,paW,paH,2)+rect(fx,gaY,gaW,gaH,2)+dot(fx+spot,my,4)
      +rect(fx+fw-paW,paY,paW,paH,2)+rect(fx+fw-gaW,gaY,gaW,gaH,2)+dot(fx+fw-spot,my,4)
      +arc('M '+(fx+c)+' '+fy+' A '+c+' '+c+' 0 0 1 '+fx+' '+(fy+c))
      +arc('M '+(fx+fw-c)+' '+fy+' A '+c+' '+c+' 0 0 0 '+(fx+fw)+' '+(fy+c))
      +arc('M '+fx+' '+(fy+fh-c)+' A '+c+' '+c+' 0 0 1 '+(fx+c)+' '+(fy+fh))
      +arc('M '+(fx+fw)+' '+(fy+fh-c)+' A '+c+' '+c+' 0 0 0 '+(fx+fw-c)+' '+(fy+fh));
  }

  /* ---- scattered pixel-art players (fixed, subtle) ---- */
  var PL=[[0.06,0.20],[0.15,0.74],[0.30,0.42],[0.49,0.82],[0.67,0.30],
          [0.85,0.66],[0.93,0.22],[0.42,0.15],[0.75,0.85],[0.22,0.93]];
  function placeSprites(){
    var layer=document.getElementById('sprite-layer');
    if(!layer||!window.SPRITES||!SPRITES.length) return;
    var d=document.documentElement, W=d.clientWidth, H=d.clientHeight; layer.innerHTML='';
    PL.forEach(function(p,i){
      var src=SPRITES[i%SPRITES.length]; if(!src) return;
      var sz=40+(i%3)*8, rot=(i%2?1:-1)*(4+i%9);
      var img=document.createElement('img'); img.src=src; img.setAttribute('aria-hidden','true');
      img.style.cssText='position:absolute;left:'+Math.round(p[0]*W-sz/2)+'px;top:'+
        Math.round(p[1]*H-sz/2)+'px;width:'+sz+'px;height:auto;opacity:0.55;transform:rotate('+
        rot+'deg);image-rendering:pixelated;image-rendering:crisp-edges;';
      layer.appendChild(img);
    });
  }

  /* ---- deck: delayed-snap + reveal + dot/keyboard navigation ---- */
  if('scrollRestoration' in history){ try{ history.scrollRestoration='manual'; }catch(e){} }
  try{ window.scrollTo(0,0); }catch(e){}

  var root=document.documentElement, snapTimer=null;
  function enableSnap(){ root.classList.add('snap-on'); }
  function suspendSnap(ms){ root.classList.remove('snap-on'); clearTimeout(snapTimer); snapTimer=setTimeout(enableSnap, ms||900); }
  function goTo(pg){ suspendSnap(900); pg.scrollIntoView({behavior:'smooth'}); }

  function initDeck(){
    if(document.querySelector('.deck-dots')) return;
    var pages=Array.prototype.slice.call(document.querySelectorAll('.page'));
    if(!pages.length) return;
    var nav=document.createElement('div'); nav.className='deck-dots';
    pages.forEach(function(pg,i){
      var b=document.createElement('button'); b.type='button';
      b.setAttribute('aria-label','Seite '+(i+1));
      b.addEventListener('click',function(){ goTo(pg); });
      nav.appendChild(b);
    });
    document.body.appendChild(nav);
    var dots=nav.children, current=0;
    var io=new IntersectionObserver(function(entries){
      entries.forEach(function(e){
        if(e.isIntersecting && e.intersectionRatio>=0.55){
          e.target.classList.add('in-view');
          current=pages.indexOf(e.target);
          for(var k=0;k<dots.length;k++){ dots[k].classList.toggle('active', k===current); }
        }
      });
    },{threshold:[0.55]});
    pages.forEach(function(p){ io.observe(p); });
    document.addEventListener('keydown', function(ev){
      if(ev.key==='ArrowDown'||ev.key==='PageDown'){ if(current<pages.length-1){ ev.preventDefault(); goTo(pages[current+1]); } }
      else if(ev.key==='ArrowUp'||ev.key==='PageUp'){ if(current>0){ ev.preventDefault(); goTo(pages[current-1]); } }
    });
  }

  function boot(){ drawField(); placeSprites(); initDeck(); }
  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', boot);
  window.addEventListener('load', function(){ boot(); setTimeout(enableSnap, 1600); });
  setTimeout(boot, 600);
  setTimeout(enableSnap, 3500);            /* fallback if 'load' is delayed */
  window.addEventListener('resize', function(){ drawField(); placeSprites(); suspendSnap(700); });
})();
</script>
```

```{python}
#| label: setup
import json, warnings, base64 as _b64, io as _io, os as _os
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
import plotly, plotly.graph_objects as go
from collections import deque as _deque
from PIL import Image as _PILImage
from IPython.display import HTML, display
warnings.filterwarnings('ignore')

# Write plotly.min.js inline into _plotly_inject.html so Quarto includes it in <head>.
# include-in-header is processed by Pandoc BEFORE --embed-resources, so the JS
# lands inline in the final self-contained HTML — bypassing the file:// CORS block.
_pjs_path = _os.path.join(_os.path.dirname(plotly.__file__), 'package_data', 'plotly.min.js')
with open(_pjs_path, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as _pf:
    _pjs = _pf.read()
with open('_plotly_inject.html', 'w', encoding='utf-8') as _hf:
    _hf.write(f'<script type="text/javascript">\n{_pjs}\n</script>\n')

TOP5    = ['GB1','ES1','L1','IT1','FR1']
LNAMES  = {'GB1':'Premier League','ES1':'La Liga','L1':'Bundesliga','IT1':'Serie A','FR1':'Ligue 1'}
LCOLORS = {'GB1':'#04f5ff','ES1':'#F1BF00','L1':'#d10214','IT1':'#008c45','FR1':'#ffffff'}

# ── Load JSONL (club-level per season) ─────────────────────
rows = []
for _lg in TOP5:
    with open(f'data/{_lg}_long.jsonl') as _f:
        for _line in _f:
            _d = json.loads(_line)
            _d['competition_id'] = _lg
            rows.append(_d)
df = pd.DataFrame(rows)
df['season'] = df['season'].astype(int)
df = df[df['season'].between(2010, 2024)]

# ── Load CSV data ──────────────────────────────────────────
clubs = pd.read_csv('data/transfermarkt/clubs.csv')[['club_id','domestic_competition_id']]
tr_raw = pd.read_csv('data/transfermarkt/transfers.csv')
pv_raw = pd.read_csv('data/transfermarkt/player_valuations.csv')
players = pd.read_csv('data/transfermarkt/players.csv')[['player_id','name','sub_position']]
games = pd.read_csv('data/transfermarkt/games.csv')

# ── Helpers ────────────────────────────────────────────────
def parse_season(s):
    try: return 2000 + int(str(s)[:2])
    except: return None

def hex_to_rgba(h, a=0.35):
    h = h.lstrip('#')
    r,g,b = int(h[0:2],16), int(h[2:4],16), int(h[4:6],16)
    return f'rgba({r},{g},{b},{a})'

def themed(fig, height=460):
    fig.update_layout(
        height=height,
        dragmode=False,
        paper_bgcolor='rgba(0,0,0,0)',
        plot_bgcolor='rgba(0,0,0,0.22)',
        font=dict(color='rgba(255,255,255,0.82)',
                  family='Aptos Light,Helvetica Neue,sans-serif', size=12),
        legend=dict(bgcolor='rgba(0,0,0,0)', borderwidth=0,
                    font=dict(color='rgba(255,255,255,0.75)', size=11)),
        hoverlabel=dict(bgcolor='rgba(10,10,10,0.88)',
                        bordercolor='rgba(255,255,255,0.18)',
                        font=dict(color='#fff', size=12)),
        margin=dict(l=60, r=20, t=36, b=50)
    )
    fig.update_xaxes(
        gridcolor='rgba(255,255,255,0.07)',
        linecolor='rgba(255,255,255,0.25)',
        tickfont=dict(color='rgba(255,255,255,0.68)'),
        title_font=dict(color='rgba(255,255,255,0.52)', size=11)
    )
    fig.update_yaxes(
        gridcolor='rgba(255,255,255,0.07)',
        linecolor='rgba(255,255,255,0)',
        tickfont=dict(color='rgba(255,255,255,0.68)'),
        title_font=dict(color='rgba(255,255,255,0.52)', size=11)
    )
    return fig

def ch(fig):
    return fig.to_html(
        full_html=False, include_plotlyjs=False,
        config={'responsive': True, 'displayModeBar': False,
                'scrollZoom': False, 'doubleClick': False}
    )

def sec(label, h2, story, chart_str, hl='', hl_type='gold', cap='', bridge=''):
    hl_s  = f'<div class="highlight-box {hl_type}"><p>{hl}</p></div>' if hl else ''
    cap_s = f'<div class="chart-caption">{cap}</div>' if cap else ''
    br_s  = f'<p class="bridge-line">{bridge}</p>' if bridge else ''
    return (f'<section class="page"><div class="page-inner spread">'
            f'<div class="col-text">'
            f'<p class="section-label">{label}</p>'
            f'<h2>{h2}</h2>'
            f'<p class="story-text">{story}</p>'
            f'{hl_s}{br_s}'
            f'</div>'
            f'<div class="col-chart">{chart_str}{cap_s}</div>'
            f'</div></section>')

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# DATA: Section 1 — Die Schere
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
mv_df = df.groupby(['competition_id','season'])['total_market_value'].sum().reset_index()
mv_pivot = mv_df.pivot(index='season', columns='competition_id', values='total_market_value').fillna(0) / 1e9

ratio_s = pd.DataFrame({
    'season': mv_pivot.index,
    'ratio': (mv_pivot['GB1'] / mv_pivot[['ES1','L1','IT1','FR1']].mean(axis=1)).values
})

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# DATA: Section 2 — Transfer-Dominanz
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
tr = tr_raw.copy()
tr['yr'] = tr['transfer_season'].apply(parse_season)
tr = tr.dropna(subset=['yr']); tr['yr'] = tr['yr'].astype(int)
tr = tr.merge(clubs.rename(columns={'club_id':'from_club_id','domestic_competition_id':'from_league'}),
              on='from_club_id', how='left')
tr = tr.merge(clubs.rename(columns={'club_id':'to_club_id','domestic_competition_id':'to_league'}),
              on='to_club_id', how='left')

tr5 = tr[tr['from_league'].isin(TOP5) & tr['to_league'].isin(TOP5) &
         (tr['transfer_fee'] > 0) & (tr['from_league'] != tr['to_league']) &
         tr['yr'].between(2012, 2024)].copy()

sankey_flows = tr5.groupby(['from_league','to_league'])['transfer_fee'].sum().reset_index()
sankey_flows['fee_m'] = (sankey_flows['transfer_fee'] / 1e6).round(1)

# Net balance per league per season (from jsonl: all transfers)
net_df = df.groupby(['competition_id','season'])['net_transfer_record'].sum().reset_index()
net_df['net_m'] = (net_df['net_transfer_record'] / 1e6).round(1)

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# DATA: Section 3 — Spielerwert-Konzentration
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
pv = pv_raw.copy()
pv['date'] = pd.to_datetime(pv['date'], errors='coerce')
pv5 = pv[pv['player_club_domestic_competition_id'].isin(TOP5)]
latest_pv = pv5.sort_values('date').groupby('player_id').last().reset_index()
latest_pv = latest_pv[latest_pv['market_value_in_eur'] >= 5e6].merge(
    players, on='player_id', how='left'
)
top500 = latest_pv.nlargest(500, 'market_value_in_eur').copy()
top500['mv_m'] = top500['market_value_in_eur'] / 1e6
np.random.seed(42)
top500['jitter'] = np.random.uniform(-0.38, 0.38, len(top500))
top500['lg_idx'] = top500['player_club_domestic_competition_id'].map(
    {lg: i for i, lg in enumerate(TOP5)}
)
top500['y_pos'] = top500['lg_idx'] + top500['jitter']

# Treemap: latest season club MVs
tm_df = df[df['season'] == 2024].copy()
# branchvalues='remainder': parent values are ADDED to children, so set parents=0.
# Leaf clubs carry all the area → no rounding mismatch possible.
tm_labels  = ['Gesamt']
tm_parents = ['']
tm_values  = [0]          # root contributes no extra area
tm_colors  = ['rgba(0,0,0,0)']
tm_text    = ['']
for _lg in TOP5:
    _d = tm_df[tm_df['competition_id'] == _lg].nlargest(12, 'total_market_value')
    _total = int(_d['total_market_value'].sum() / 1e6)
    tm_labels.append(LNAMES[_lg]); tm_parents.append('Gesamt')
    tm_values.append(0)             # league contributes no extra area
    tm_colors.append(LCOLORS[_lg])
    tm_text.append(f'€{_total/1000:.1f}B')
    for _, _r in _d.iterrows():
        _mv = int(_r['total_market_value'] / 1e6)
        tm_labels.append(_r['name']); tm_parents.append(LNAMES[_lg])
        tm_values.append(_mv)
        tm_colors.append(hex_to_rgba(LCOLORS[_lg], 0.72))
        tm_text.append(f'€{_mv}M')

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# DATA: Section 4 — Wettbewerb
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
g5 = games[games['competition_id'].isin(TOP5) & games['season'].between(2012, 2024)].copy()
g5['home_pts'] = np.where(g5['home_club_goals'] > g5['away_club_goals'], 3,
                 np.where(g5['home_club_goals'] == g5['away_club_goals'], 1, 0))
g5['away_pts'] = np.where(g5['away_club_goals'] > g5['home_club_goals'], 3,
                 np.where(g5['home_club_goals'] == g5['away_club_goals'], 1, 0))

home_r = g5[['competition_id','season','home_club_id','home_club_name','home_pts']].rename(
    columns={'home_club_id':'club_id','home_club_name':'club_name','home_pts':'pts'})
away_r = g5[['competition_id','season','away_club_id','away_club_name','away_pts']].rename(
    columns={'away_club_id':'club_id','away_club_name':'club_name','away_pts':'pts'})
all_pts = pd.concat([home_r, away_r])
standings = all_pts.groupby(['competition_id','season','club_id','club_name'])['pts'].sum().reset_index()
standings['rank'] = standings.groupby(['competition_id','season'])['pts'].rank(
    ascending=False, method='min').astype(int)

# Join with club MV from jsonl
df_mv = df[['club_id','season','total_market_value','competition_id']].copy()
scatter_df = standings.merge(df_mv, on=['club_id','season','competition_id'], how='inner')
scatter_df = scatter_df[scatter_df['total_market_value'] > 0].copy()
scatter_df['mv_m'] = scatter_df['total_market_value'] / 1e6

# MV rank within each league-season (1 = richest)
scatter_df['mv_rank'] = scatter_df.groupby(['competition_id','season'])['mv_m'].rank(
    ascending=False, method='first').astype(int)
scatter_df['n_clubs'] = scatter_df.groupby(['competition_id','season'])['club_id'].transform('count')

def _mv_grp(r, n):
    p = r / n
    if p <= 0.25:  return '① Top-25%'
    elif p <= 0.60: return '② Mittelfeld'
    else:           return '③ Unteres Drittel'

scatter_df['mv_grp'] = scatter_df.apply(lambda x: _mv_grp(x['mv_rank'], x['n_clubs']), axis=1)
_grp_order = ['① Top-25%', '② Mittelfeld', '③ Unteres Drittel']
grp_avg = (scatter_df
    .groupby(['competition_id','mv_grp'])['rank']
    .mean().reset_index()
    .rename(columns={'rank':'avg_rank'}))

# Top-4 share of total MV per league-season (replaces Gini)
def _top4_share(g):
    tot = g['total_market_value'].sum()
    return g.nlargest(4,'total_market_value')['total_market_value'].sum() / tot * 100 if tot else np.nan

top4_df = df.groupby(['competition_id','season']).apply(_top4_share).reset_index()
top4_df.columns = ['competition_id','season','top4_pct']

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# DATA: Section 5 — Brain Drain / PL Tax
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
tr_pl = tr[(tr['to_league'] == 'GB1') &
           (tr['transfer_fee'] > 1e6) &
           (tr['market_value_in_eur'] > 1e6) &
           tr['from_league'].isin(TOP5)].copy()
tr_pl['fee_m']     = tr_pl['transfer_fee'] / 1e6
tr_pl['mv_m']      = tr_pl['market_value_in_eur'] / 1e6
tr_pl['premium']   = ((tr_pl['fee_m'] / tr_pl['mv_m']) - 1) * 100
tr_pl = tr_pl[tr_pl['mv_m'] >= 5].copy()

# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# KPIs for hero
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
_total_mv_2024   = mv_pivot.loc[2024, TOP5].sum()
_total_mv_2010   = mv_pivot.loc[2010, TOP5].sum()
_mv_growth       = int((_total_mv_2024 - _total_mv_2010) / _total_mv_2010 * 100)
_total_transfers = tr5['transfer_fee'].sum() / 1e9
_top_league      = mv_pivot.loc[2024, TOP5].idxmax()
_top_league_name = LNAMES[_top_league]
_top_league_mv   = mv_pivot.loc[2024, _top_league]
_num_transfers   = len(tr5)

# ── Load SVG logos as base64 data URIs ────────────────────
import os as _os, base64 as _b64_logo
_LOGO_FILES = {'GB1':'pl','ES1':'laliga','L1':'bundesliga','IT1':'seriea','FR1':'ligue1'}
_LOGOS = {}
for _lg, _fn in _LOGO_FILES.items():
    try:
        with open(f'logos/{_fn}.svg','rb') as _lf:
            _b = _b64_logo.b64encode(_lf.read()).decode()
        _LOGOS[_lg] = f'data:image/svg+xml;base64,{_b}'
    except:
        _LOGOS[_lg] = ''

# ── Transfermarkt wordmark (PNG) as base64 data URI ───────
try:
    with open('logos/transfermarkt-logo.png','rb') as _tmf:
        _TM_LOGO = 'data:image/png;base64,' + _b64_logo.b64encode(_tmf.read()).decode()
except:
    _TM_LOGO = ''

# ── Sprite background removal ─────────────────────────────
def _remove_bg(path, tol=22):
    img = _PILImage.open(path).convert('RGBA')
    arr = np.array(img, dtype=np.int32)
    bg  = arr[0, 0, :3]
    h, w = arr.shape[:2]
    alpha   = arr[:, :, 3].copy()
    visited = np.zeros((h, w), dtype=bool)
    q = _deque()
    for r, c in [(0,0),(0,w-1),(h-1,0),(h-1,w-1)]:
        if not visited[r,c]: q.append((r,c)); visited[r,c] = True
    while q:
        r, c = q.popleft()
        if np.abs(arr[r,c,:3] - bg).max() <= tol:
            alpha[r,c] = 0
            for nr, nc in [(r-1,c),(r+1,c),(r,c-1),(r,c+1)]:
                if 0<=nr<h and 0<=nc<w and not visited[nr,nc]:
                    visited[nr,nc] = True; q.append((nr,nc))
    arr[:,:,3] = alpha
    buf = _io.BytesIO()
    _PILImage.fromarray(arr.astype(np.uint8)).save(buf, 'PNG')
    return 'data:image/png;base64,' + _b64.b64encode(buf.getvalue()).decode()

_sprite_b64 = []
for _i in range(1, 16):
    try:    _sprite_b64.append(_remove_bg(f'assets/sprite_{_i:02d}.png'))
    except: _sprite_b64.append('')

_sprites_js = 'var SPRITES=[' + ','.join(f'"{s}"' for s in _sprite_b64) + '];'
display(HTML(f'<script>{_sprites_js}</script>'))
```

```{python}
#| label: hero
_logo_strip = ''.join([
    f'<div class="league-badge">'
    f'<img src="{_LOGOS[lg]}" alt="{LNAMES[lg]}">'
    f'</div>'
    for lg in TOP5 if _LOGOS.get(lg)
])

# ── KPI tiles: preserved for later use (not rendered on the intro page) ──
# To bring them back, drop {_kpi_grid} into the hero markup below.
_kpi_grid = f'''
      <div class="kpi-row">
        <div class="kpi-card accent">
          <span class="kpi-number gold">€{_total_mv_2024:.1f}B</span>
```

```{python}
#| label: s4a-mv-corr
# ── Chart 4A: Pearson correlation MV vs. final rank per league per season ─
from scipy.stats import pearsonr

corr_rows = []
for lg in TOP5:
    for ssn, grp in scatter_df[scatter_df['competition_id']==lg].groupby('season'):
        if len(grp) >= 5:
            r, _ = pearsonr(grp['mv_m'], -grp['rank'])
            corr_rows.append({'competition_id': lg, 'season': ssn, 'r': round(r, 3)})
corr_df = pd.DataFrame(corr_rows)

fig = go.Figure()
for lg in TOP5:
    _d = corr_df[corr_df['competition_id']==lg].sort_values('season')
    fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(
        x=_d['season'], y=_d['r'],
        mode='lines+markers',
        name=LNAMES[lg],
        line=dict(color=LCOLORS[lg], width=2),
        marker=dict(size=5, color=LCOLORS[lg]),
        hovertemplate='<b>%{x}</b>: r = %{y:.2f}<extra>' + LNAMES[lg] + '</extra>'
    ))
fig.add_hline(y=0, line_color='rgba(255,255,255,0.2)', line_dash='dot')
fig.update_layout(
    xaxis_title='Saison',
    yaxis=dict(title='Pearson-Korrelation (Kaderwert ↔ Tabellenplatz)', range=[-0.1, 1.05]),
    legend=dict(orientation='h', yanchor='bottom', y=1.01, xanchor='left', x=0)
)
themed(fig, height=420)

display(HTML(sec(
    'Akt IV · Marktwert = Leistung?',
    'Je reicher der Kader, desto besser der Platz — in allen fünf Ligen.',
    ('Die Pearson-Korrelation misst, wie stark der Kaderwert den Tabellenplatz voraussagt '
     '(1.0 = perfekte Übereinstimmung, 0 = kein Zusammenhang). '
     'Ein Wert über 0.7 gilt als starker Zusammenhang. '
     'Die Linien zeigen: In jeder der fünf Ligen kauft Geld seit Jahren zuverlässig Punkte.'),
    ch(fig),
    hl=('Die Korrelation liegt in allen Ligen konstant zwischen 0.6 und 0.9 — '
        'mit leichten Schwankungen je nach Saison. '
        '<strong>Geld erklärt den Erfolg ligaübergreifend</strong>, '
        'nicht nur in einer einzigen Liga.'),
    cap='Pearson-Korrelation pro Saison und Liga · Basis: Kaderwert und Abschlusstabellenplatz (2012–2024)'
)))
```

```{python}
#| label: s5a-pl-tax
# ── Chart 5A: Median premium % per season per buying league ──
_tax_all = []
for lg in TOP5:
    _d = tr[(tr['to_league'] == lg) &
            (tr['from_league'] != lg) &
            (tr['from_league'].isin(TOP5)) &
            (tr['transfer_fee'] > 1e6) &
            (tr['market_value_in_eur'] > 5e6) &
            (tr['transfer_season'].str[:2].apply(lambda x: 2000+int(x) if x.isdigit() else int(x)).between(2012, 2024))].copy()
    _d['fee_m'] = _d['transfer_fee'] / 1e6
    _d['mv_m']  = _d['market_value_in_eur'] / 1e6
    _d['premium'] = ((_d['fee_m'] / _d['mv_m']) - 1) * 100
    _grp = _d.groupby('transfer_season')['premium'].median().reset_index()
    _grp['league'] = lg
    _tax_all.append(_grp)
tax_df = pd.concat(_tax_all).rename(columns={'transfer_season': 'season', 'premium': 'med_pct'})

fig = go.Figure()
fig.add_hline(y=0, line_color='rgba(255,255,255,0.2)', line_dash='dot')
for lg in TOP5:
    _d = tax_df[tax_df['league']==lg].sort_values('season')
    fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(
        x=_d['season'], y=_d['med_pct'].round(1),
        mode='lines+markers',
        name=LNAMES[lg],
        line=dict(color=LCOLORS[lg], width=2),
        marker=dict(size=5, color=LCOLORS[lg]),
        hovertemplate='<b>%{x}</b>: +%{y:.1f}%<extra>' + LNAMES[lg] + '</extra>'
    ))
fig.update_layout(
    xaxis_title='Saison',
    yaxis=dict(title='Median-Aufschlag gegenüber Marktwert (%)', ticksuffix='%'),
    legend=dict(orientation='h', yanchor='bottom', y=1.01, xanchor='left', x=0)
)
themed(fig, height=420)

display(HTML(sec(
    'Akt V · Transfer-Aufschläge',
    'Die Premier League zahlt am meisten über Marktwert — aber sie ist nicht allein.',

     'gegenüber dem offiziellen Transfermarkt-Wert berechnet. '
     'Dargestellt ist der Median-Aufschlag pro Saison und Käuferliga. '
     'Ein Wert von +33% bedeutet: Diese Liga zahlte im Schnitt ein Drittel mehr als der Spieler "wert" war.'),
    ch(fig),
    hl=('Die Premier League zahlt strukturell den höchsten Aufschlag — '
        'doch auch andere Ligen überzahlen in bestimmten Saisons deutlich. '
        '<strong>Der sogenannte Premier-League-Tax setzt den Marktpreis, dem alle folgen müssen.</strong>'),
    hl_type='red',
    cap='Transfers zwischen Top-5-Ligen · Ablöse > €1M, Marktwert > €5M von 2012–2024'
)))
```
